notes.title: The District 3 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Respondrs! 

We are pleased to inform you that Embr has finally expanded to the Upper North Side, the wealthiest district in the city. For high networth and corporate clients whose cliffside mansions or high rises are burning down, Embr is now just a few taps away. Currently, Upper North Side brings 5 new neighborhoods, including a new showdown with ███████████████ Australian competition.

Give the new District a try and let us know your feedback by filling out this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeaGR2wFyY6Xh6ZEpxr5Mi-QAyUXFGwIl8z-2RRHIetqlvfPw/viewform?usp=sf_link]form![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/25aa1eb77ca9b4308fbe33851cfa8a1e50cb9315.gif[/img]

[b]New Content: [/b]

New Upper North Side district with 5 new levels

[u]Mystery Manors [/u]
Experience the grand clockwork centerpiece of this picturesque manor built and previously owned by a mystery novelist! 

[u]Yachtster Rent-A-Yacht[/u] 
Enjoy this scenic cruise along an artificially created glacial corridor right here in the city. Don’t forget to turn off the engine and enjoy the views!

[u]Crab and Go: Claw Club[/u] 
Only the most upscale diners are invited to the Claw Club. Redeem your spot in the rooftop ballpit by accumulating enough reward points at any Crab N Go location!

[u]Rockside Resort [/u]
All the fun of a mountain getaway, with none of the climbing! Get up to the amenities with our unique tramway, sponsored by BluStuff!

[u]Mysterious Signal from Embr HQ[/u]
Return to where it all began, and find out what’s going on at Embr HQ. Remember your training Respondr... 

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list][*] New: Co-default mission types! Some district 1 levels will start with a choice between rescue and another mission type for first time players
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/54836b2dedef147f5a55f86b55a21ebdaba2c4cd.png[/img]
[*] Added: Steam Rich Presence
[*] Added: Discord Rich Presence
[*] Added: 13 new achievements!
[list][*] Your lobby basketball practice will finally pay off![/list]
[*] Added: In salvage missions, items that start outside, or are otherwise unrescuable will appear red.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/9ec0cd8a4979d2730cfda41e372a02334723edc1.png[/img]
[*] Added: Rescued and stolen items get a specific color tint to indicate if they are stolen or rescued.
[*] Adjusted difficulty in District 2 boss mission’s final room. Hard mode should be somewhat easier. Easy mode should be significantly easier.
[*] Default FOV changed to 75
[*] Default View Bob Reduction changed to 33[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes and Changes: [/b]
[list][*] Fixed: Clients not taking as much fall damage as they should
[*] Fixed: Ceiling bubble fire effects not vanishing when the fire is extinguished
[*] Fixed: Revived clients not counting as fed for Embr Eats if they had been fed before dying
[*] Fixed: Hair Dryer cooling mode not having any effect
[*] Change: Adjust rescue zone location for hard mode in Newton Ave 
[*] Fixed: Extended spool graphic not enabling when equipped
[*] Fixed: Various issues with doors not rendering correctly
[*] Fixed: Parachutes on physics props looking incorrect for non host players
[*] Fixed: Player getting stuck inside spawned car in lobby
[*] Updated: Credits
[*] Fixed: Various missing clothes renderers for players
[*] Fixed: Possibility that hose was less effective when running at low framerate with reduced physics quality setting enabled
[*] Fixed: Various missing or invisible geometry issues on levels
[*] Various other bug fixes and performance improvements[/list]

Thank you so much for your support, and enjoy District 3!

Don’t forget to [url=http://discord.gg/embr]join our Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/EmbrGame]follow us on Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: Embr Demolition Update out now
notes.notes:
Greetings Respondrs! 

When you sign up with Embr, you can expect to make money, and it is our mission to help you do just that by ever expanding our products and services. This month, we are again proud to introduce a truck load of new and exciting additions to Embr. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/ccf51bed0957d2623326567f45da5d1ea6b2160a.gif[/img]

[b]New Game Mode -  Demolition:[/b]
Here at Embr, we’re always looking for new growth opportunities to pass on to our Respondrs! So we’re happy to announce Embr Demolition! Need to liquidate some capital tied up in real estate? Have some toxic assets you need dealt with? Hire an Embr Respondr! Using their expertise and experience with fire, Respondrs will quickly and cleanly demolish the building, leaving you with a fresh plot of land ready for new construction! Our Respondrs offer the fastest demolition times in the industry, thanks to a unique time based commission system. The faster it’s done, the more they get paid! So hire an Embr Respondr today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/9de1f1db877da48b7cff48bcf8a1b242668635a7.png[/img]

[b]Gold and Diamond Tier Rewards:[/b]
In addition to cold hard cash, Responders now have the opportunity to join the Embr rewards program and earn Gold and Diamond tier points. Use these points to unlock the most powerful upgrades and equipment. Gold and Diamond points now unlock certain valuable equipment. Earn Gold from special missions, and Diamonds for completing every special mission in a neighborhood! In the near future, be on the lookout for daily and weekly missions and challenges specifically designed for reward program members. Stay tuned! We’ll have more to unlock soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/77692e76bfc7966bbc4101413df097a57026ee75.gif[/img]

[b]New Tool - The Toilet Grenade ($500, 2 Gold): [/b]

For a long time Respondrs have been challenged by the problem of clients who just can’t contain their excitement about Embr’s amazing firefighting services. Many react in different, sometimes unpredictable ways. Now Embr has found a way to channel that energy into helping clients help themselves! Simply deploy the new Golden Toilet Grenade and all nearby clients will be attracted to it immediately! Be careful though, clients will prioritize the toilet over their own safety! Buy one now using Embr Gold!

[b]New Upgrades:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ice Gun
[list]
[*] Refillable Ice ($1500, 3 Gold)[list]
[*] Refill at sinks, but be careful, it drinks up water quickly!
[/list]
[/list][list]
[*] Client Safety Insurance ($1000)
[list]
[*] Use the ice gun while carrying clients, just like you would a standard issue fire hose!
[/list]
[/list][*] Jump Pad
[list]
[*] Auto Cancel ($500)
[list]
[*] Tired of bouncing around uncontrollably? With the auto cancel upgrade, landing on a jump pad will allow you to fall softly.
[/list]
[/list]
[list][*] Rubberization Applicator ($500, 1 Gold)
[list]
[*] Launched objects will take significantly reduced damage upon landing after using the jump pad.
[/list]
[/list]
[list][*] Parachute Application ($2000, 1 Diamond)
[list]
[*] Applies a standard issue parachute to any object, client, or Respondr launched.
[/list]
[/list]
[/list][b]Balance Changes:[/b]
Clients in District 1 too often use construction materials that are a touch too flammable and electric outlets of generic brands, and this has made solo Respondr calls riskier.  We’ve worked with clients to better fireproof their premises so that Respondrs could make the same tips with ⅓ of the effort.
 
[list]
[*] New armor and respawn systems: Player more resistant to and heals faster from sudden hazard damages the first time through in a level. Player also receives extra spawns upon death for their first several missions. 
[*] Adjustments to fire spread and fire starts throughout District 1. 
[*] Adjustments to introduction, pacing, and placement of hazards, obstacles, and props throughout District 1. 
[*] Adjustments to total client count and minimum rescue success criteria in some District 1 levels as well as the Gaslight campaign. 
[*] Water levels have been adjusted. Be careful to manage your water and keep an eye out for sinks in missions.
[*] Various tool costs have been adjusted, many including new Gold and Diamond currencies.
[/list]
In addition, clients now notice you stealing their valuables in a new way. The more clients you currently have rescued, the more likely they are to notice you taking their things. If they notify you that they’re removing a star, you won’t get it back, but if they don’t tell you that, it means you will still receive your normal rating for the mission. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/f4961c16a4ec02902e632aa75e53e2c9a54f5903.jpg[/img]

[b]New Heads Up Display: [/b]
For Respondrs rushing into burning buildings, there’s arguably nothing more important than the HUD.  So it should come as no surprise that we’re introducing the Embr HUD 2.0! A lot of the things that Respondrs have been clamouring for to make the HUD easier to use and provide more information are now in. Enjoy!

In Newton Ave., you’ll get a first taste of upscale security with the keycard system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/dbb3ae3a63a19433e8d6abf7a3f93e4611c93a95.gif[/img]

[h2]Hey Respondrs! [/h2]
We have a new feature and an update on the input lag issue that people have been reporting. 

[h1]Update on Input Lag Issue[/h1]
With the issue of input lag when running with Vulkan (the default game start option). This is looking like an issue that the game engine we used introduced in their latest update, and it is unfortunately affecting the game. We’re working to find a mitigation for this problem, but until then, here are a few workarounds that could help alleviate the issue:
[olist][*] Turn off Vsync in Video Settings in game. 
[*] Play the game in windowed mode
[*] Start and play the game with the “Play Embr (DX11)” start option[/olist]
Hope this helps! Thanks for your patience and really sorry for the issue everyone!

[h3]Steam Cloud Support[/h3]
We’re also happy to announce that Embr now supports Steam Cloud!

In order to create the Steam Cloud save file, please launch Embr on your computer and change a loadout to make it save (look for the “saving” icon in the lower right corner of the screen). That should have your save data saved on Steam Cloud!

If you encounter any issues with Steam Cloud or have any other issues, please feel free to email us at feedback@musegames.com anytime. 

Thanks so much again!
